champions.evidence: cdragon-16.20: the 74 DA_ entries with traits give 14/13/14/14/10 champions per cost plus 9 Lux forms, matching tactics.tools/info/units; the other entries (TFT_*, cost 8/11) are PvE monsters, dummies and anvils

variant_groups.note: Lux forms share the Avatar trait; counted as one champion with forms

item_kinds.evidence: plain tag 'component' on the 10 DA_Component_* and 10 TFT_Item_* basic components
349 entries; descriptions use <Set18CharmUpgrade> and names match the Wisps in the 18.1-18.4 notes (Drizzle, Grove Armor, Returning Friend, Room for a Shroom); hash name not resolved
all 80 entries are DA_Artifact_* or known artifacts; hash name not resolved
all 72 entries are named 'Radiant ...'; hash name not resolved
emblems without the TraitItem tag (e.g. DA_18_EmblemCoven)
72 entries, all with a two-component recipe; hash name not resolved
Tactician's items have a recipe but not the tag above
everything else: assist rewards, potions, legacy entries
